synthesis:draft.headline: Operational demand is the EMMS field OPERATIONAL_DEMAND used for operations; the central-dispatch Total Demand excludes the local consumption of scheduled loads.

document_statements.quote: Measured operational demand is field “OPERATIONAL_DEMAND” in EMMS Data Model, as described in Appendix A2.
Operational demand adjustments include: • Activated RERT; and • Involuntary load shedding that occurred as a result of a NER 4.8.9 instruction for load shedding from AEMO

document_statements.paraphrase: Total Demand used in central dispatch excludes the local demand of scheduled loads and scheduled BDUs.

The EMMS Dispatch formula for TotalDemand subtracts the contribution of regional scheduled loads from the summed scheduled and semi-scheduled generation (i.e. generation minus scheduled loads, plus other components).
